title: Resolve a knowledge anchor from a work item or the feature's history dir
action: Add a shared anchor resolver in a new knowledge/anchor.rs and make BOTH copies of build_context_manifest use it, in this one cell (per D8 — drivers/tests.rs:881-905 byte-compares only the kctx copy, so moving one copy alone lets them drift with every test green). The resolver returns a work-item arm when a bee.work-item concept's bee.id matches the requested id, which always wins (per D5); otherwise a history arm built from docs/history/<id>/CONTEXT.md and plan.md, whichever exist, both when both do (per D6); otherwise nothing, which each caller renders as today's unknown_work message unchanged, byte for byte, including its D27 tag. The history arm carries the meta text (the slug plus each file's first heading, read from disk — never composed prose, per D10 in docs/knowledge/areas/okf-profile/concept-model-and-authoring.md:55), the body text, the repo-relative paths, and the summed real byte size. In context.rs and kctx.rs: feed the resolver's meta and body to score_critical_relevance in place of meta_text_of plus concept_body; make the anchor the rank-1 manifest entry with its real byte size, because select() at context.rs:243-250 drops any path that is not a bundle concept and metadata() at context.rs:395 joins against docs/knowledge, so a history path would otherwise vanish and rank_one_cost at context.rs:403 would silently reserve against the top critical instead; report zero_signal in the manifest instead of throwing it whenever the anchor is the history arm, keeping the throw for the work-item arm (per D7 — the work concept's tags and bee.areas carry TAG_WEIGHT and AREA_WEIGHT at context.rs:32-34, and a history anchor has neither, so more criticals land at exactly 0.0 for a reason that is an artifact of the anchor kind); and add an anchor object naming its kind and paths to the manifest header at context.rs:461-473, plus one plain-text line naming the anchor (per D1). Leave the bee.plan sibling lookup, the required_context walk, and the decisions read exactly as they are — all three already degrade to empty without panicking under the history arm. Judge the existing coverage first: unknown_work is pinned at verbs/knowledge/tests.rs:312 and :505, the manifest shape at :235, :1120, :1173, :1272 and :1335, and the port parity at drivers/tests.rs:881-905. Author only the gap.

truths: bee knowledge context --work <slug> returns a ranked manifest for a slug that has no bee.work-item concept but has docs/history/<slug>/CONTEXT.md
A slug whose docs/history/<slug>/ holds only plan.md also resolves
A slug with a bee.work-item concept still produces today's manifest and reports the work-item anchor kind
A slug with neither a work-item concept nor any history file still refuses with the unchanged unknown_work message and exit code
A history anchor whose text drives most criticals to zero reports zero_signal and exits 0; a work-item anchor in the same state still throws
The anchor entry carries the real byte size of the files it was built from, never zero

artifacts.substantive: the Anchor type and resolve_anchor, with the work-item arm preferred over the history arm and no TODO stubs

key_links: knowledge/mod.rs declares and re-exports the anchor module
context.rs build_context_manifest calls resolve_anchor instead of its own work-item find
drivers/kctx.rs build_context_manifest calls the same resolve_anchor
prohibitions: No file under docs/knowledge/ is created, moved, or deleted
The unknown_work message text and exit code do not change in either copy
A work-item anchor's manifest stays byte-identical to today's apart from the added anchor field

trace.outcome: Added a shared docs/history/ fallback anchor resolver; both build_context_manifest copies consume it, with the anchor as rank-1 manifest entry, zero_signal reported under a history anchor, and 4 new tests including a cross-port parity check
